chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī wrote to Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام:
Concerning a woman who breastfed a man's child: is it permissible for that man to marry the daughter of this wet nurse or not?
So he عليه السلام wrote in reply: “That is not permissible for him.”

key_terms.أَرْضَعَتْ: breastfed; established the act of nursing that creates milk kinship
key_terms.الْمُرْضِعَةِ: the wet nurse; the woman who breastfed the child
key_terms.وَلَدَ: the child; the man's child who was nursed

ai.seo_question: Is a man allowed to marry the daughter of a woman who breastfed his child?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question sent to Imam al-ʿAskarī عليه السلام regarding milk kinship through breastfeeding. The Imam عليه السلام ruled that a man may not marry the daughter of the woman who breastfed his child, establishing a prohibition in marriage related to radaʿah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4669 - Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari wrote to Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari (as)

asking about a woman who breastfed a man's child.
He asked: "Is it permissible for that man to marry the daughter of this wet nurse or not?"
Imam (as) responded, "It is not permissible for him."
